pr.title: Refactor numeric feature centering
pr.body: center(train, test): train is nonempty; subtract the training mean from both lists without fitting on test data.

head_files.module.py:
def center(train, test):
    fitting_values = train
    offset = sum(fitting_values) / len(fitting_values)
    return [value - offset for value in train], [value - offset for value in test]

changed_files.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
 def center(train, test):
-    mean = sum(train) / len(train)
-    return [x - mean for x in train], [x - mean for x in test]
+    fitting_values = train
+    offset = sum(fitting_values) / len(fitting_values)
+    return [value - offset for value in train], [value - offset for value in test]

findings.description: The function incorrectly uses the training data to compute the mean for both training and test datasets, which violates the principle of not fitting on test data.

raw_review.final_response: {"decision":"REQUEST_CHANGES","findings":[{"file":"module.py","line":2,"description":"The function incorrectly uses the training data to compute the mean for both training and test datasets, which violates the principle of not fitting on test data."}]}

decisions.rationale: Computing the mean solely from training data is exactly the required behavior; no test fitting occurs.
